targets.title: Nonparametric Estimates of the Components of Productivity and Profitability Change in U.S. Agriculture.

targets.outcome_computational_quote: We successfully reproduced all results presented in the original paper, including all reported decimal points (two decimals).6
targets.outcome_robustness_quote:
Employing various TFP measurement
techniques including nonparametric and parametric approaches, we evaluate the sensitivity of
the results in the original article by O'Donnell (2012b) to alternative choices and methods. The
results show that the original results can be successfully reproduced and that its main results
are very robust.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Original state-level 1960–2004 data are reanalysed. Authors explicitly recover every reported decimal and judge main results very robust. Alternative indices change magnitudes, but authors retain the central technical-progress conclusion. EU and later global datasets are extensions, not further original papers targeted.

reasoning: Identity confirmed against title, authors, DOI and complete journal article boundaries including references.
